_comment: Page refresh registry for the VR.org maintenance audit. Each page lists its file path, refresh cadence in days, and a one-line refresh checklist. Run `npm run audit:pages` to see what is overdue.
policy: Best-of and pillar pages drive the majority of vr.org traffic. They must be refreshed on the cadence below. Real content edits required, not just dateModified bumps (Google's freshness signals discount unchanged content). Category hubs auto-fill from articles.json, but featured pins in data/featured.json, on-page descriptions, and CATEGORY_GUIDES links in src/components/CategoryHub.tsx all rot independently and need weekly verification.

checklist: Verify each headset's price and availability in deals.json
Update 'What's Coming in 2026' section with confirmed launches
Refresh FAQ if a major release shifts the buyer recommendation
Verify Quest 3S ($349) and PSVR2 ($399) new prices against data/deals.json
Re-check approximate used prices for Quest 3 (~$400) and Quest 2 (~$150); the secondary market moves
Confirm the Quest 2 still plays the current must-play titles (some new games drop Quest 2 support over time)
Update 'What to Avoid' if a notable cheap headset or display-glasses entrant appears
Keep the cross-link up to /best-vr-headsets and down from it intact
Top 10 all-time list rarely changes; review for new instant classics
Refresh Honorable Mentions with the year's standout titles
Update FAQ if a new game enters the must-play conversation
Move shipped games from 'anticipated' to 'released so far' with launch dates
Add internal links to VR.org launch articles for each
Refresh FAQ to reflect the released-not-anticipated lineup
Tighten the 'What to watch for' close based on the latest hardware news
Verify each app is still actively maintained (kill anything shuttered)
Refresh the Honorable Mentions section with new apps gaining traction
Update the visionOS / Meta AI / spatial-AI commentary
Verify subscription pricing for each app (Supernatural, FitXR, Les Mills)
Add new fitness titles that have launched since last refresh
Refresh the 'How to get started' tips with the latest accessory recs
Verify the recommended first headset is still the right call
Update 'What to play first' list if a new beginner-perfect title shipped
Keep accessory pricing within ~20% of current retail
AR moves fast. Refresh 'What is coming' with confirmed Android XR / Meta / Apple news
Update Ray-Ban Meta, Rokid, Xreal, Viture pricing and feature notes
Add any new entrant that has captured > 5% of category share
Evergreen explainer; only update when the technology landscape shifts meaningfully
Verify the 'history' and 'future' sections still reflect current state
Update headset pricing references
Hub page; verify card grid links match the live pillar pages
Update card descriptions if a pillar page shifts focus
Scan for new VR products (headsets, accessories, AR glasses) that could displace a current pillar pick
Source of truth is data/deals.json, not the page
Verify every product is still in stock and price is within ~10% of listed
Scan for new VR product launches in the last 7d (headsets, AR glasses, controllers, accessories) and add the worthwhile ones
GPU prices are volatile through the DRAM cycle; spot-check Newegg / Amazon listings
Remove EOL or out-of-stock items
Source of truth is data/events.json (EventsCalendar auto-buckets past vs upcoming)
Add upcoming VR / AR conferences and game launches
Prune events older than ~90 days from the JSON to keep the file small
Verify featured: true is set on the marquee events (CES, GDC, WWDC, Connect, AWE, Gamescom)
Verify hardware-category featured pins in data/featured.json are not expired (expiresAt > today)
Sanity-check the on-page description (HardwarePage in page.tsx) still names the right headset families
Confirm CATEGORY_GUIDES['hardware'] in src/components/CategoryHub.tsx links to current pillar pages
Spot-check the live feed; if no new hardware articles in 7d, investigate bot/source health
Verify gaming-category featured pins in data/featured.json are not expired
Sanity-check the on-page description in src/app/gaming/page.tsx
Confirm CATEGORY_GUIDES['gaming'] in src/components/CategoryHub.tsx still points at the best-vr-games pillars
Spot-check the live feed for gaps in coverage of a major release week
Verify software-category featured pins in data/featured.json are not expired
Sanity-check the on-page description in src/app/software/page.tsx
Confirm CATEGORY_GUIDES['software'] in src/components/CategoryHub.tsx (best-vr-apps, best-vr-fitness) is current
If visionOS / Horizon OS / Android XR has shipped a major release, reflect it in the description
Verify enterprise-category featured pins in data/featured.json are not expired (currently rotating slowly)
Sanity-check the on-page description in src/app/enterprise/page.tsx
GAP: CATEGORY_GUIDES has no 'enterprise' entry in src/components/CategoryHub.tsx; add one when a relevant pillar page exists
Spot-check the live feed; enterprise has lower article volume so a sparse week is normal
Verify AR-category featured pins in data/featured.json are not expired
Sanity-check the on-page description in src/app/ar/page.tsx
Confirm CATEGORY_GUIDES['ar'] in src/components/CategoryHub.tsx points at ar-glasses and a relevant headset pillar
AR moves fast; if a major device shipped this week (Ray-Ban, Rokid, Xreal, Samsung), make sure coverage landed
Verify XR-category featured pins in data/featured.json are not expired
Sanity-check the on-page description in src/app/xr/page.tsx
Confirm CATEGORY_GUIDES['xr'] in src/components/CategoryHub.tsx is still relevant
Spot-check the live feed; XR overlaps heavily with AR so volume should be steady
Verify at least one new VR.org original has published in the last 7d (originals is the editorial differentiator)
If the last original is > 14d old, treat as overdue and queue a piece
Sanity-check the on-page description in src/app/originals/page.tsx
Confirm featured original articles are routing through the editorial pin path (not RSS featured)
Verify team / contributor list is current (no departed staff still listed)
Confirm contact info, social links, and editorial-policy statement still match reality
Update mission / about copy only when the publication's positioning meaningfully shifts
Annual legal review; verify Amazon Associates disclosure language matches the program agreement
Verify analytics / ad-network vendors listed match what is actually loaded in src/components
Update the 'last updated' line on the page itself when the policy substantively changes
